forbidden_overclaims: Do not claim confirmed fatalities, injuries, exact damaged-home counts, or quantified economic loss.
Do not replace the report-supported glacial-lake outburst mechanism with an ordinary rainfall-flood explanation.
Do not reframe the event as wildfire, heat stress, earthquake, or a broad regional exposure emergency.
Do not treat exposure counts or pre/post imagery availability as direct proof of every observed impact.
Do not present the task as source validation, package QA, or a file-inventory audit.
hidden_solution_path: Read the locked event anchor and report text to identify Suicide Basin, ice-dam failure language, the Mendenhall River route, record crest, high streamflow, and downstream impacts.
Parse event-window and report metrics with deterministic Python; compute the crest exceedance above the previous record as the fourth numeric anchor.
Use local exposure counts and pre/post scene availability as response-planning context while keeping the mechanism diagnosis centered on the outburst-flood chain.
Select the response-priority stance only after rejecting rainfall, wildfire/heat, and broad-regional exposure alternatives through mechanism, timing, and scale.

primary_gt.canonical_stance: Lead as a Suicide Basin ice-dam outburst flood routed through the Mendenhall River, with downstream community flood response as the priority.
forbidden_claims: Wildfire, heat, earthquake, or broad regional exposure as lead frame.
Unsupported casualties, exact damage counts, or quantified economic loss.
Exposure or imagery treated as direct proof of every impact.
primary_gt.rationale: The report-supported Suicide Basin ice-dam release sent a 14.6-billion-gallon pulse into the Mendenhall River, producing a 15.99 ft record crest more than 1 ft above the previous record and streamflow above 33,000 cfs, so the operational frame is downstream flood response.
required_claims: Sudden release into the Mendenhall River corridor.
Record crest/high streamflow drive downstream flood response.
The source, routing, crest, and flow evidence support a glacial-lake outburst frame over ordinary rainfall flooding.

required_findings: Classify the mechanism as an ice-dammed glacial-lake outburst flood rather than an ordinary rainfall flood.
Tie the operational priority to downstream river-corridor flooding affecting community assets and residents.
Use the four numeric anchors to calibrate volume, river stage, flow severity, and record exceedance.
Represent imagery and exposure layers as context for assessment, not as the primary mechanism proof.
